title: ReviewResult
description: Contract for the `review` and `audit` --format json output (report.ReviewResult). The audit path reuses ReviewResult, so both commands share this schema.

findings.description: Findings ordered by severity. Encoded as null (not []) when there are none.

gates.description: Per-run counts for the hygiene stages of a review or an audit: the line anchor, the two demotion gates, and the changed-file check, which only a review runs. The anchor and the check never demote. The counts describe the whole run, not the filtered finding list. Absent when no stage ran, or on results produced before gate recording existed; an absent stage object means 'not recorded', not 'nothing demoted'.

passes.description: How each secondary pass the run requested ended (the adversarial pass, the coverage map, the feature-compliance check, each domain specialist), named by the session label usage.passes uses. Absent when the run requested none, and on results produced before pass recording existed. The primary review is never listed: its failure fails the run.

excluded_files.description: Changed files the review's sessions were not pointed at, set only with --diff-exclusions: lock files, vendored directories (one entry per directory, with how many changed files under it were left out), and generated files. Absent when exclusions are off or no changed file matched.

snippet_check.description: The snippet gate's per-finding record: 'passed', a 'verified: <how>' string, or a 'demoted: <reason>' string. Set by the pipeline, never by the model.

claim_check.description: The claim gate's per-finding record. Set by the pipeline, never by the model.

line_check.description: The line anchor's per-finding record: 'anchored' kept the model's range, 'reanchored' moved it within the file, 'relocated' moved it to another changed file, 'unanchored' found no single place for the quote at the reviewed head. Set by the pipeline, never by the model.

gateStats.description: Per-run counts for each hygiene stage, and the changed-file record. A missing stage object means the stage never ran this run; a missing files object means the review prompt listed no changed files.

anchorGateStats.description: The line anchor's counts, taken over each pass's findings before the merge, so a defect that several passes report counts once per pass. The findings confirmed on the model's range ('anchored') are examined minus the other three.

examined.description: Findings that carry a file and a non-blank quote.

reanchored.description: Findings moved to the quoted code in the same file.

relocated.description: Findings moved to the one other changed file that holds the quote. Absent when zero.

unanchored.description: Findings whose quote pins no single place in the head content; they keep the model's line.

recovered_outside_diff.description: Findings whose quoted code was absent from the changed files but found elsewhere in the checkout, and so were kept. Absent when zero, and never set by an audit.

fileGateStats.description: The changed-file check: the review session's own account of the files its prompt listed, compared with that list. It never moves a finding.

changed.description: The files the review prompt listed: the changed files minus the excluded files and the .planwerk/ planning artifacts.

reviewed.description: The listed files the session reported reading.

missing.description: Every other listed file, in listed order. Absent when the session reported reading every one.

status.description: skipped: the session said it did not read the file, with its reason. unreported: its account left the file out.

error.description: Set for a failed pass only: the first line of its error, secrets redacted, at most 200 bytes.

path.description: Repository-relative path; a vendored directory ends in '/'.

files.description: Set for a vendored directory only: how many of its changed files were left out.
